params.markdown:
The Keep dashboard includes various visualizations for tracking actions performed in Google Keep by users. It features visualizations such as a map for plotting the locations of users who performed the actions, a pie chart for analyzing distribution of event names, bar char to analyze top note owners by event count and a line chart tracking event trends over time. These insights help administrators understand user behavior, system events, data security, and the utilization of various data sources within the workspace.
